description_en: Invokes the RedeployInstance operation to redeploy an ECS instance when the ECS instance receives a system event notification
description_zh: 当ECS实例收到系统事件通知时，调用RedeployInstance可以重新部署这台ECS实例
kebab_example: aliyun ecs redeploy-instance --instance-id i-bp1azkttqpldxgted0000 --force-stop false --region cn-hangzhou
name: RedeployInstance

parameters.description_en: The instance ID. The instance must be in the Running or Stopped state.
parameters.description_zh: 处于运行中或者已停止状态的实例ID。
parameters.help_en: The instance ID. The instance must be in the Running or Stopped state
parameters.help_zh: 处于运行中或者已停止状态的实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.description_en:
Specifies whether to forcefully stop the instance that is in the Running state.

Default value: false.

> A forced stop is equivalent to a typical server power-off. Data in the instance operating system that has not been written to storage devices is lost. Redeploy instances that are in the Stopped state whenever possible.
parameters.description_zh:
是否强制停止运行中（Running）的实例。

默认值：false。

> 强制停止等同于典型的服务器断电关机，实例操作系统中暂未写入存储设备的数据会丢失。建议您尽量对已停止实例做重新部署操作。
